scope: GitHub auto-merge trigger sequential conflict-guard harness moved from shell to Rust
implementation_summary: Added scripts/tests/trigger_next_queue_automerge_conflict_guard.rs with a compiled Rust fake gh binary and a compiled guard-wrapper binary named at the legacy compatibility path inside the temporary fixture repository.
Preserved clean dry-run, clean non-dry-run, and merge-conflict scenarios while ensuring the non-dry-run fake merge refuses to record a merge unless the sequential guard marker exists.
Updated BUCK so //:github-auto-merge-after-ci-check compiles and runs the Rust conflict-guard harness instead of invoking bash for the retired shell test.

Updated specs/phase0-auto-merge-after-ci.json, specs/buck2-authority-policy.json, and scripts/tests/phase0_auto_merge_after_ci_contract_check.rs to require the Rust harness path and reject stale shell-test restoration.
